It selects ~7 smart-ocean startups (<7 years) for a ~6-month program with corporate open-innovation matching.

Ran '미래식단 (The Food Changers)' with Lotte Accelerator and the Foundation of Agri. Tech Commercialization to discover, grow, invest in and provide R&D support for foodtech startups.

summary.en: Wecook is a shared-kitchen / F&B startup platform that runs a 12-week foodtech accelerator. Tech Commercialization, covering future food, care food, sustainable ingredients and packaging.

strategy.thesis: Korea's first impact investor (2008), now an impact accelerator running vertical programs: 'Impact Climate' climate-tech accelerator (secondary batteries / future mobility preference) and 'IMPACT EARTH' agrifood-specialist accelerating, plus a climate-tech founder fellowship.

program.location: Seoul; Jeonbuk regional office required for climate program
program.eligibility: Impact / climate / agrifood startups founded within 7 years

application.how_to_apply: Apply via Impact Climate / IMPACT EARTH / fellowship program announcements.

summary.en: Founded 2008 as Korea's first impact investor, Sopoong Ventures is now an impact accelerator running vertical programs: a 6-month 'Impact Climate' climate-tech accelerator (₩100M–₩500M direct, TIPS up to ₩1.5B, secondary-battery/future-mobility preference, Jeonbuk base) and the 'IMPACT EARTH' agrifood accelerator, plus a climate-tech founder fellowship. ~143 cumulative portfolio companies.
summary.local: 2008년 국내 최초 임팩트 투자사로 출범한 소풍벤처스. 현재 임팩트 액셀러레이터로 6개월 기후테크 액셀러레이터 'Impact Climate'(직접투자 1~5억, TIPS 최대 15억, 이차전지·미래모빌리티 우대, 전북 거점)와 농식품 특화 'IMPACT EARTH', 기후 창업가 펠로우십을 운영. 누적 포트폴리오 약 143개사.

strategy.thesis: Public 'StyleTech' program by the Korea Institute of Design Promotion (KIDP) to directly nurture fashion/beauty startups that fuse 4th-industrial-revolution tech (AI, VR/AR, blockchain) with style, via accelerating and corporate open innovation.

program.eligibility: Fashion / beauty / style-tech startups (~80 in the ecosystem per KIDP)

application.how_to_apply: Apply via KIDP StyleTech program announcements.

summary.en: StyleTech is a public fashion/beauty accelerating program by the Korea Institute of Design Promotion (KIDP) for startups fusing style with AI/VR/AR/blockchain. It runs accelerating (operated by Vinyl-X) plus corporate open innovation and a co-working space (DKWORKS); KIDP estimates ~80 style-tech startups active.
summary.local: 한국디자인진흥원(KIDP)이 운영하는 패션·뷰티 '스타일테크' 액셀러레이팅 공공 프로그램. AI·VR·AR·블록체인을 결합한 스타일테크 스타트업을 직접 육성하며 코워킹스페이스(디케이웍스)와 바이널엑스 운영의 액셀러레이팅, 대기업 오픈이노베이션을 제공(KIDP 추산 약 80개사).
